visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit office studio, a man wearing a yellow blazer and white shirt sits across a wooden table from a woman in a beige trench coat. The man holds a white document, gesturing with his left hand while speaking with an inquisitive facial expression. The woman sits with her back straight, maintaining a calm and neutral gaze. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a different man with styled dark hair, wearing a black vest over a white collared shirt. He looks towards the left of the frame with a slightly bewildered or serious expression, his hands out of view. (3) The camera returns to the initial interview setting. The man in the yellow blazer looks down at his paper with a perplexed and slightly defeated expression, while the woman remains composed, her hands resting calmly on the table in front of her.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 職場面試講重點！. [Logo]: 這群人這群人. [Subtitle]: 你為什麼想來我們公司上班？. (2) [Subtitle]: 因為我需要錢. (3) [Subtitle]: 對，但是工作中就會賺到錢，可是妳為什麼要來我公司上班？. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為沒有錢的話沒辦法生活. (5) [Subtitle]: 除了錢跟生活以外，妳為什麼想要來我們公司裡面上班？. (6) [Subtitle]: 因為錢，我需要錢. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以沒有錢不工作. (8) [Subtitle]: 對. (9) [Subtitle]: 請問一下還有什麼問題嗎？. (10) [Subtitle]: 請問這邊的男同事帥嗎？. (11) [Subtitle]: 額我們這邊一開始可能薪水不會太高喔. (12) [Subtitle]: 嗯，那這樣一開始我工作也不會太認真. [Slogan]: 完整版 搜尋 這群人. [Slogan]: 面試的經典語錄.
